rs2043211.sentence: Genotypes AT + TT of rs2043211 are associated with decreased likelihood of response to infliximab or etanercept and increased concentrations of TNF-α and IL-1β, with higher DAS-28, in people with Rheumatoid Arthritis in Iraq as compared to genotype AA; association reported as statistically significant after 3 months of treatment.
rs2043211.explanation: In a case-control study of 100 RA patients and 100 controls, carriers of the T allele (AT/TT) at CARD8 rs2043211 showed significantly higher disease activity (DAS-28), higher serum TNF-α and IL-1β, and poorer EULAR response to anti-TNF therapy (infliximab or etanercept) at 3 months; no p-values were provided.

rs4612666.explanation: In the same RA cohort (n=100 patients), carriers of the variant allele at NLRP3 rs4612666 (TC/CC) had significantly higher disease activity and poorer EULAR response to anti-TNF therapy alongside elevated TNF-α and IL-1β; no p-values were provided.
